notes.title: New & Improved Demo!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’re very pleased to announce that a new demo is available now for Fangtopia! We will also be participating in the Steam Scream Fest starting October 28th.

Here’s a rundown of some of the changes you can expect to see in the new demo…

[b]New-style Monster Tiles[/b]
Monster tiles have been revamped in a couple of key ways. Each monster type now has its own distinct pattern that can be previewed before placing them. Not only does this make it clearer what will happen when placing monster tiles, it enhances what they bring to the tile-laying puzzle. Monsters now also animate more while on their group of tiles, helping bring your spooky worlds to life.

[b]Ghost Trains[/b]
You’ll now be able to create spectral rail networks to connect your world! We spoke about ghost trains in a previous devlog, and since then have made some changes to how they work. We found having fixed directions for track tiles to be a little cumbersome and occasionally frustrating. To solve this, we made track tiles adaptive and removed the need for station and tunnel tiles. The result is something that we hope feels much more freeing and allows you to take more creative ownership of your world.


[b]Tutorial & Controls[/b]
When you start playing the game you will no longer have a dialogue sequence with Viktor the Pumpkin King and instead be presented with some brief instructions on the rules of the game and the controls. Many players commented that it could be frustrating to have to go through Viktor’s dialogue each time they started a new game so we hope this change gets you into the action quicker and gives more useful information to help you get started.


If you’re a new or returning player we’d love to hear what you think! The feedback we received on the old demo directly helped us make improvements in today’s new demo so please leave a comment if you have any thoughts.

That’s all for now, and as always - stay spooky!

notes.title: Feature Preview: Ghost Trains
notes.notes:
Today we’re excited to share a feature you can expect to see in the full release of Fangtopia… Ghost Trains!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111962/f369d4e057f5122ab9e6da3193a05e1619f8edd3.gif[/img]

These spectral locomotives will travel across your world and add a new dimension to the core puzzle gameplay of Fangtopia.

To add a ghost train to your world, you’ll be placing railway tiles, each with their own shape. Carefully rotate these tiles to form one continuous route. The longer your route, the more points you will score!

In addition to railway tracks, you’ll be able to place special station and mountain tunnel tiles. Station tiles allow you to bridge the gap between two railway pieces that might not otherwise fit together. Mountain tunnel tiles allow you to extend your rail networks through mountain ranges and go for even higher scores.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111962/0b27a82a7823ba6d1098f723fd76c4da54021d75.jpg[/img]


And finally, a big thank you to everyone who has checked out our demo so far! You can play it here if you haven't given it a go yet: https://absolutelygames.itch.io/fangtopia

Stay spooky!

notes.title: Fangtopia Announced!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!  With the announcement of Fangtopia today, we wanted to write a small devlog introducing the game and the team behind it. If you’d like to play a demo of the game head over to our [url=absolutelygames.itch.io/fangtopia]Itch page![/url]

[b]Who are Absolutely Games?[/b]
We’re an independent team based in Guildford UK. We’re passionate about strategy and tactics games of all varieties, and we released our first game earlier this year: Classified: France ‘44.

[b]What is Fangtopia?[/b]
Fangtopia is a relaxing building game inspired by titles like Dorfromantik. As a loyal servant of Viktor the Pumpkin King, you’ll be expanding his spooky kingdom one tile at a time, creating a world suitable for your not-so-scary monsters. 

[b]Why are you making it?[/b]
We started thinking about Fangtopia as our dev time on Classified was coming to an end. We loved playing Dorfromantik and games similar to it, but found that the aesthetics of these games tended to draw from similar idyllic pastoral settings. We saw Fangtopia as an opportunity to do our own spooky take on the genre and introduce some gameplay twists that we wanted to see.

[b]When will it be done?[/b]
While we don’t have a firm timeline for when Fangtopia will be released, we hope to gradually iterate on & improve the game over the next few months. Who knows, the game may be ready in time for Halloween!

If Fangtopia looks like something you’d be interested in, please do give it a go - the team is always keen to hear any thoughts and feedback. You can play a demo for the game on our Itch page. https://absolutelygames.itch.io/fangtopia 

Cheers!
